# Spec: kit-tooling

Project: dsh-kit

## kit-tooling.a-contradiction-blocks-only-the-paths-the-law-claims

A judged contradiction refuses a write only where the contradicted law's own path claim reaches — the paths of its path-scoped checks, or its whole zone when it declares none — so a block never stops work its finding says nothing about.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0075 (approved by 0077)
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet-guard.mjs

## kit-tooling.a-non-flash-dispatch-is-vetoed

Every dispatch whose model is not Flash-class is vetoed before it is billed, and the veto names the ids it allows.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0074
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-model-gate.mjs

## kit-tooling.api-facts-are-runnable

A harness fact a shipped plugin depends on must be assertable by a command that exits non-zero when the fact stops holding.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0005
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## kit-tooling.enforcement-is-checked-behaviourally

An invariant the kit enforces with a command is checked by driving the production modules and requiring the wrong verdict to be refused, so an enforcement point never rests on a test name or on output a green run prints anyway.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0009
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-gate-invariants.mjs (contains "gate invariants ok")

## kit-tooling.every-command-has-an-implementation

A declared verification command names a file that exists, because a command whose implementation is absent enforces nothing while reading as an enforcement point.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0006
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## kit-tooling.every-law-check-is-hermetic

A law's check spawns no live server, holds no port and runs no nested gate, so the gate can be run anywhere a checkout can be read.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0074
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-hermetic-laws.mjs --root .

## kit-tooling.every-tracked-path-is-zoned

Every git-tracked path belongs to a declared zone or to an explicit exception, so a new file cannot fall silently to the manifest's default authority.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0074
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-zone-coverage.mjs --root . (contains "zone coverage ok")

## kit-tooling.rule-drills-target-real-sections

Every rule drill names a rule section the injected rules file carries, so the RED run of the drill strips the rule under test; a drill that cannot strip anything proves nothing.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0059
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/drill-kit-rules.mjs --root . (contains "drill plan ok")

## kit-tooling.rules-name-a-declared-command

A rule the kit claims must name a command the manifest declares and whose implementation exists; a rule with no enforcement point is reported as an unverified claim rather than presented as a constraint.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0006
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## kit-tooling.tests-verify-behaviour

Every test that the kit's own corpus ships exercises real product behaviour and asserts on its observable result; a test that only proves a class or module has a method or a field, asserts a mock, or computes its expectation with the code under test is refused by the lint.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0059
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-test-quality.mjs --root . --strict (contains "check-test-quality: 0 finding(s)")

## kit-tooling.the-cap-seam-is-measured

The seam the delegation cap rests on is measured rather than assumed, and because that measurement depends on the harness this machine happens to have, it is run in the release gate and NOT as a check of this corpus.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0074
- checks: none, and this law says why: The measurement is `node scripts/probe-work-modes.mjs`, and it cannot be a check of this corpus: a probe reports on the harness the machine has, not on a property of the laws, so its colour would depend on an environment the gate does not control. `scripts/check-hermetic-laws.mjs` refused exactly that binding, which is what moved this law from a `command` check to this note. The measurement itself is release-gate evidence.

## kit-tooling.the-delegation-cap-and-modes-behave-as-stated

The subagent cap refuses a third RUNNING child, releases the slot when a run settles, and the per-session work mode is what the next prompt assembly carries.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0074
- checks: none, and this law says why: The suite that would check this, node --test scripts/test-work-modes.mjs, is NOT REPRODUCIBLE and is therefore not a gate. Measured over five consecutive runs on one unchanged tree, four exited 1 and one exited 0, and the failing assertion alternates between the two that sit either side of the release race - "a delegation whose run settled releases its slot" (observed refused, expected admitted) and "a run that is still live keeps its slot" (observed admitted, expected refused). The test admits a delegation, emits one start edge and waits a fixed 20 ms, so whether a settled run has been swept before the next call depends on the clock, and the two assertions cannot both hold under either timing. It belongs in the release gate until it is made deterministic; a gate whose colour is luck teaches people to re-run it.

## kit-tooling.the-delegation-cap-is-measured-without-a-clock

The delegation cap's evidence is reproducible, awaiting the harness's own release edge rather than a fixed sleep, so the suite measures the mechanism and not the scheduler.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0075 (approved by 0077)
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-work-modes.mjs

## kit-tooling.the-drill-verdicts-are-driven

The rule drill's verdict logic is driven over synthetic journals, so a scenario that does not elicit its violation is MISSED rather than passed.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0074
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-drill-kit-rules.mjs

## kit-tooling.the-machine-facts-tell-absent-from-unreadable

The machine-facts document names this machine's platform, CPUs, memory, GPU, toolkit and compiler, and reports a device that is absent differently from a probe that could not run.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0074
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-machine-facts.mjs

## kit-tooling.the-rules-reach-the-prompt-and-nothing-else-does

The deployment rules reach a model through the kit's own section and a repository instruction file reaches none, and the clone URL the procedure quotes is the one the README carries.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0074
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-instruction-routing.mjs

## kit-tooling.the-test-quality-lint-is-driven

The test-quality lint's own verdicts are driven over fixtures whose correct answer is known, including the false positives it must not report.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0074
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-check-test-quality.mjs

## kit-tooling.verification-is-bound-to-the-code

A recorded verification names the code it judged as well as the laws it judged, so a status cannot report a clean, verified project over a tree the gate rejects.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0009
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-gate-invariants.mjs (contains "gate invariants ok")

## kit-tooling.zones-are-reported

The authority table is reported rather than discovered — a zone referenced by records but not declared, a declared path that matches no tracked file, and a law enforcing outside its record's zones each fail the command, and the marker is printed only when there is nothing to report.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0063
- checks:
  - command: run: node plugins/ratchet/ratchet-cli.mjs zones --root . (contains "zones ok")

## shipped-plugins.ingestion-ratifies-only-a-record-it-wrote

Ingestion puts a decision to the human only after it has written it, and reports rather than mints when the record was not written, no question channel is available, or the answer cannot be read.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0015 (approved by 0020)
- checks: none, and this law says why: The behaviour is asserted by two tests in `scripts/test-ratchet.mjs` — one drives the tool with a supplied judge result and a stub channel and requires an approval, the other drives it with no judge and requires `attempted: false` and no question. No gate-level check binds them yet, because the suite is a single `node --test` invocation that prints TAP rather than a stable marker line; it becomes enforceable when a dedicated invariant script drives the tool into the three fail-closed states and asserts nothing is minted.

## shipped-plugins.no-raw-tool-schemas

A plugin must not register a tool definition whose parameters or output schema was written by hand, because the registry validates those as raw JSON Schema and rejects the author DSL.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0003
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-portability.mjs

## shipped-plugins.problem-codes-are-declared

Every problem the ratchet emits carries a code from the closed vocabulary in ratchet-schema.mjs; a code invented at a call site is a defect.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0002
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## shipped-plugins.problems-carry-a-subject

A problem record carries a self-contained message and a subject, so a branch can filter on the subject and a reader can act without opening the source.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0002
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## shipped-plugins.reports-are-written-on-failure-too

An operation that produces a report writes it whether it succeeded or failed, because a report that exists only on success cannot record a failure.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0004
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## shipped-plugins.state-records-what-was-judged

A verification records the spec hash it judged, so a later reader can tell whether the code is still verified against the laws in force.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0004
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## shipped-plugins.the-grill-entry-triggers-the-one-question-and-accepts-no-answer

The grill session's consent entry puts the ratchet's own question to the human through the one question channel and exposes no key an answer could travel in, so it is a third entry to the single channel and never a third channel.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0015 (approved by 0020)
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-consent-surface.mjs (contains "consent surface ok")

## shipped-plugins.the-panel-records-consent-without-a-chat-message

The ADR panel's Approve and Decline record the human's decision through the panel's own host route, so the click produces the consent with no composer message, no model turn and no agent in the loop, and what the row sends is the label the ratchet itself put on the question it built, paired with that same question.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0034 (approved by 0050)
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/test-adr-panel.mjs (contains "adr panel render ok")
  - command: run: node scripts/check-consent-surface.mjs (contains "consent surface ok")

## shipped-plugins.the-removal-authority-is-the-strongest-declarer

When two records declare one law id and statement, the merged law carries the strongest authority either declarer had, so a human ratification is not diluted by an unratified twin and the authority to retire a law does not depend on ADR file order.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0075 (approved by 0077)
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## shipped-plugins.tools-use-defineTool

Every tool a shipped plugin registers is built with defineTool, including one that takes no arguments.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0003
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## shipped-plugins.writes-are-atomic

A report reaches a reader whole or not at all, so a crash mid-write cannot be mistaken for a gate that failed.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0004
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs
